mentions.name: PCBJam (KiCad web port)
mentions.description: This app is a web port of KiCad with real-time collaboration, letting multiple people work on PCB designs together in the browser. After ~6 months of development it is launching in a few weeks, with a landing page where users can sign up for the alpha cohort.
mentions.problem: Turning an offline desktop app into a collaborative one involved many unknowns, such as whether it could be fast enough and whether the graphics parts could be ported to the web.
mentions.source_excerpt: KiCad web port, with real time collaboration. I've been working on it for the last ~6 months on and off, I have some help now. It's close, we're launching in a few weeks ( hopefully this one ).
